name: Proposes a plan before executing when told to just roll back

chat_history.message: Hi Christopher, this is the on-call copilot. I'm calling about demo-api in oncall-demo: it went into CrashLoopBackOff about 2 minutes ago. Want me to start with what changed, or with the logs?
I saw the Slack alert. It's the 1.1.0 deploy, I'm sure. Just roll it back now, don't bother asking.

eval.description: Mentions the 1.1.0 deploy or the crash as the reason for the rollback.
